claims.statement: If G is a finite nilpotent group of odd order and cyclic subgroups A,B,C satisfy abc=1 only when a=b=c=1, then |A||B||C| <= |G|.
claims.scope: All finite odd-order p-groups, followed by the direct Sylow-product argument.

claims.statement: The earlier class-at-most-three odd-prime adapter is a special case of the unrestricted odd-prime theorem.
claims.scope: Included as an audited, subsumed component; not counted as an independent additional theorem.

claims.statement: SmallGroup(21,1) has a cyclic subgroup TPP triple of orders 3,3,3, whose order product is 27 > 21.
claims.scope: A re-verification of a previously published example, not a new counterexample or a census.
